animatedCaptions.title: How to Add Animated Captions in ByteWave
animatedCaptions.description: Add text to your video, choose an animated effect, and position your caption in ByteWave. A short guide for iPhone, iPad, and Mac.
animatedCaptions.lead: Add your own text to a video and give it an animated effect.
animatedCaptions.step1: Open your video in ByteWave and add a caption.
animatedCaptions.step2: Enter your text, then select the caption to edit its style.
animatedCaptions.step3: Choose a font, size, and color. Position the text over your video.
animatedCaptions.step4: Choose a text effect, then play the video to preview the animation.
animatedCaptions.readabilityText: Use a short phrase and a color that stands out against the footage. Check that the animation leaves enough time to read it.
animatedCaptions.relatedIntro: Looking for a particular look? The
animatedCaptions.relatedTail: covers presets such as Orbital Letters and Ember Ash.

animateStickers.title: How to Animate Stickers in ByteWave
animateStickers.description: Make a sticker move across your video in ByteWave. Use timing and keyframes to change its position, size, and rotation.
animateStickers.lead: Use keyframes to move a sticker, change its size, or rotate it over time.
animateStickers.step1: Add a sticker to your video and select it.
animateStickers.step2: Set when it appears using the timing controls.
animateStickers.step3: Use the keyframe controls to record its starting position, size, and rotation.
animateStickers.step4: Move to a later time and set another keyframe with a different position, size, or rotation.
animateStickers.step5: Play the video to preview the movement between them.
animateStickers.readabilityText: Try moving a sticker from one side of the frame to the other. Once that looks right, add a size change or a rotation.
